blocks.heading: Short Answer
blocks.write: Two to four sentences that answer the question.
The full explanation, divided into sections under second-level headings.
A deadline or a time limit the reader must not miss, in a sentence or two.
A closing call to action, only when the article's own instructions ask for one: one short paragraph that says what to do next, with a link to the contact page.
Small print that applies to the whole article, only when the article's own instructions ask for a disclaimer.
